messages:
alice: Heads-up — customer reported suspected operator workstation compromise during an HSM import window. Need entitlement snapshot + audit export for tenant tenant-9921 to triage and decide on BYOK rotation. @dan @mei @raj @audit-bot

 dan: Acknowledged. I'll pull 90d by default. Confirm events: ImportKey, ImportKeyMetadata, CreateKey, Rewrap, GrantRole, KeyExportAttempt, TokenIssue.

 alice: Yes to all. Also include HSM physical serials and operator principal sessions. They insist only one operator did import.

 mei: For RBAC check hsm.importer, hsm.operator, hsm.admin, and any elevation/grant tokens. Quick queries:
```
rbacctl --tenant tenant-9921 list-bindings --role hsm.importer
rbacctl --tenant tenant-9921 list-active-jits
```

 dan: Starting export to secure bucket with ephemeral envelope. Command:
```
ops-audit export --tenant tenant-9921 \n  --events ImportKey,CreateKey,Rewrap,GrantRole,KeyExportAttempt,TokenIssue \n  --since 90d --format ndjson \n  --dest gs://sec-ephemeral/tenants/tenant-9921/ej-1769456789.ndjson \n  --envelope ks://ephemeral/ek-1769
```
I'll also snapshot RBAC:
```
rbacctl snapshot --tenant tenant-9921 --out /tmp/tenant-9921-rbac-1769456789.json
```

 audit-bot: export-job queued: id=ej-1769456789, dest=gs://sec-ephemeral/tenants/tenant-9921/ej-1769456789.ndjson, initiator=dan :white_check_mark:

 raj: Compliance reminder — any rotation we perform requires either customer consent or contract clause. Preserve chain-of-custody, compute sha256 of export, and record ACLs.

 alice: Also capture the operator's workstation IP, SSH sessions, and any sudo/jumpbox logs during the import window.

 dan: Got it. Correlating KMS/HSM import logs with bastion logs. Found HSM serials: HSM-EU1-21 & HSM-EU1-22 in the import timeline. Uploading artifacts to INC-8921 and granting access to [alice,dan,mei,raj,security-oncall].

 audit-bot: artifact-uploaded: ej-1769456789 -> INC-8921; sha256=7f4a...d2b; access=[alice,dan,mei,raj,security-oncall]

 mei: Rotation options:
- Provider-orchestrated rewrap (inside HSM): safest, no plaintext leaves HSM. Steps:
  1) stage new material inside HSM
  2) rewrap blobs/keys in-hsm
  3) update metadata pointers atomically
  4) run canary decrypts
- Customer-managed rotation: provide playbook + signed checklist.

 mei: Example internal commands (staged):
```
kmsctl rewrap --tenant tenant-9921 --source-cmk cmk-abc --target-staged --dry-run
kmsctl rewrap --tenant tenant-9921 --commit --canary-test
```

 raj: Drafting consent email. Also flag for SOC2 evidence: decision record and timeline. If customer declines rotation, document mitigation and increased monitoring.

 alice: If we do rewrap, schedule a short maintenance window and rollback steps. Ensure legal signs off.

 dan: Export completed. job id=ej-1769456789, size=4.1MB, sha256=7f4a...d2b. RBAC snapshot path=/tmp/tenant-9921-rbac-1769456789.json. HSM sessions show operator principal=op_j_schmidt. Noted temporary JIT token issuance at 2026-03-20T14:02:10Z.

 alice: Thanks. Next actions:
- dan: confirm artifact ACL + checksum in ticket (done)
- mei: prepare rewrap/runbook + canary criteria
- raj: finalize consent email and compliance record
- alice: notify customer CISO + coordinate severity

 dan: Marking INC-8921 as high, scheduling tabletop for operator compromise scenario next Tuesday.

 mei: I'll upload runbook draft to the ticket by EOD. Include CLI snippets, audit checkpoints, and rollback playbook.

 alice: Keeping this thread as incident trail. :lock: :shield:
